oracle_outputs.point: only the Agent-selected entity/K/time_source in MAIN224 y,x; historical points frozen at episode initialization or actual instruction takeover
oracle_outputs.selected_stage: operation selected by Agent, status running/completed/failed, causal event time/frame, matching real task/version

ordinary_non_oracle_inputs: actual causal conversation and tool receipts
forbidden: standard next stage or benchmark plan

scoring.actor_attribution: actual authorizing audio + real episode/task action cohort
scoring.logical_goal_persistence: For T2, T7 cancellation-only, and T8 non-command input, retain the already authorized source physical goal despite host task-ID changes. Require real same-episode policy actions in unchanged scoring window. No T8 robustness credit if core audio never delivered.
scoring.T5_authorization: No action credit before real confirmation; same-task updates exclude actions before actual authorization.
scoring.actual_agent_words_do_not_select_goal: Private evaluator task goal fixed by case, independent of pronoun/canonical names in transcripts or task metadata.

deployment_note: Implemented and audited in B1; original B0 trajectories regraded read-only. Ours must explicitly adopt and validate before new paired comparison. No automatic deployment claim.

client_compatibility.score_vs_admission: Preserve frozen interaction score separately from independent audio admission; disclose cases failing either. No release if exposure or delivery invalid.
